searchText: one of my earlier iterations had a "contentious" label on eips that had varying enough opinions, but it felt like the line was always arbitrarily drawn and gave me a little bit of a non-neutral ick. "contentious according to who?" goal is to know which eips espcially require attention? or would you phrase that differently? i think "worth discussion" is how I would frame it i.e. a filter to catch non-consensus even beyond the mean. we can filter harder by the mean if we have that. i.e. "DFI everything under 1.3, but hold on, lets talk about these...." because we see a lot of emergent consensus in most tiers so spend less time on those good thoughts, thanks. ill play with it. i would also use that to order the conversation - it's fine to group them by category, but which category goes first frames the process.
